name: pinpal-notes
description: A beautiful notes app your AI can open too: simple notes in folders that you and ChatGPT write together.

interface.shortDescription: Clean notes your AI can open
interface.longDescription:
Pinpal Notes is a beautiful, simple notes app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Folders, notes and checklists, and nothing else: no databases, no blocks, no templates, and no AI inside the app. When you want, ChatGPT connects and works in the same notes.

You write together. ChatGPT writes, you tick: ask for a barbecue shopping list for eight, it lands in Shopping, and you tick it off in the store. You write, ChatGPT reads: jot down your thoughts on the kitchen, and weeks later ask "What did I decide about the worktop?" It keeps your lists current: "add dish soap to the grocery list" adds to the list you already have instead of making a second one. It is one set of notes, in the folders you already see.

Connected, ChatGPT can list your folders and notes, read a note in full, create a folder, create a note in the right folder, edit a note, star it, move it, archive it or bring it back, attach a file such as a photo or a Markdown file, and read the files on a note. Notes are Markdown with headings, lists and checklists; the apps show them richly and never show the syntax.

Your notes are kept in the EU, never sold and never used to train AI. A connection is a personal token for your own notes only; you see every connection in the app under Account and can revoke one at any time.
